english.title: Drive a vehicle with faecal / offensive matter likely to be nuisance / cause damage to a Mersey tunnel / injure a person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnel approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

drove a vehicle containing

(C)_[faecal, offensive or noxious matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATTER..),]_
(D)_[a substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SUBSTANCE..),]_

likely to be a nuisance or cause damage to the tunnels, the tunnels' approaches, the marshalling areas or to persons using the same
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(p) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
